content: Multi-brand/white-label consensus architecture: token hierarchy primitives -> semantic -> component; CSS custom properties are the right tool for runtime brand switching; brands override a small semantic token layer under a scoping selector (attribute like data-brand) while sharing HTML/behavior/structural CSS. White-label overrides focus almost always on color + typography (+ radius). Lyra's 4-token brand contract with color-mix derivation matches and simplifies the industry pattern.
